notify_user.desc: Send a non-blocking toast notification to the user. Does not wait for a response.

params.title: Notification title. Default: "AI Assistant"
params.duration_seconds: How long the toast stays visible (Windows/Linux only). Default: 5 s.

ask_user.desc: Ask the user a question via a dialog and wait for their answer. Use this instead of asking questions in response text. A browser-based dialog appears (falls back to console). Set non_blocking=true if your MCP client has a short timeout, then poll with get_user_response.

params.question: The question to present to the user
params.title: Dialog window title. Default: "AI Assistant"
params.subtitle: Subtitle shown below the title (e.g. your agent name).
params.choices: Optional quick-reply chips. User can tap a chip and/or type a custom reply.
params.allow_freeform: Allow freeform text input alongside choices. Default: true.
params.notify: Flash taskbar and send a toast when dialog opens. Default: true.
params.non_blocking: Return a poll token immediately instead of waiting. Use when MCP client timeout is short (e.g. 30–120 s).

get_user_response.desc: Poll for a pending ask_user(non_blocking=true) response. Returns PENDING until answered.

params.wait_seconds: Seconds to wait per poll. Default: 55. Max: 115.

update_dialog.desc: Send a live update into an open non-blocking ask_user dialog (macOS only).

params.message: The message to display in the dialog

open_chat.desc: Open a persistent two-way browser chat window. Returns a chat_id. macOS only.

params.title: Title shown in the chat window. Default: "AI Assistant"
params.subtitle: Optional subtitle (e.g. your agent or model name).

send_chat_message.desc: Send an AI message into an open chat window.

get_chat_messages.desc: Poll for new user messages from an open chat window. Returns PENDING or CLOSED.

params.wait_seconds: Seconds to wait per poll. Default: 55. Max: 115.

close_chat.desc: Close a chat window and free its port. Call when the session is finished.

rest.desc: Show an 'AI is resting' page so the user can wake you when ready. Returns a poll token (use get_user_response). macOS only.

params.notes: Message shown to the user while resting.
params.title: Name shown in the resting UI. Default: "AI Assistant"
params.subtitle: Optional subtitle, e.g. your agent or model name.
params.timeout_seconds: Max seconds before auto-waking. Default: 3600. Max: 86400.
